# Tabler dashboard assets

Tabler Core 1.6.1, MIT license (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/releases/tag/@tabler/core@1.6.1

Unmodified distribution files from the pinned npm package:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.6.1/dist/css/tabler.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.6.1/dist/js/tabler.min.js

The report generator embeds these assets in index.html, so viewing a saved
report does not require a CDN connection or a frontend build.
